reproducibility_gaps: CUDEM is continuously updated and the paper does not identify the exact historical tile IDs, filenames, revision dates or frozen product snapshot used for St. Thomas and St. Croix.
The paper documents VIVD09-to-WGS84 conversion with NOAA VDatum but not the exact VDatum software/model version or transformation parameters.
No CUDEM tile was downloaded or opened, so exact file-level schema, checksums and paper-specific spatial subset were not independently verified.
notes: R2 reflects a persistent official CUDEM product family, public distribution, citation metadata and paper-documented validation/datum workflow.
R3 is withheld because the continuously updated product is not tied to an exact historical tile snapshot used by the paper.
